title: Symmetry of the probability inner product
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. For $\langle f,g\rangle_\pi=\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)f(x)g(x)$, one has $\langle f,g\rangle_\pi=\langle g,f\rangle_\pi$.
